supported.description: We support conversions between the following formats:

examples.title: 💡 Conversion Examples
examples.video: • **Video:** MP4 → AVI, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV etc.
examples.document: • **Documents:** DOCX → PDF, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT
examples.spreadsheet: • **Spreadsheets:** XLSX → XLS, ODS, CSV, TXT (PDF excluded)

pdfWarning.title: ⚠️ PDF Conversion Limitations
pdfWarning.description:
**Conversion from PDF to other formats is not supported.**
PDF can only be used as an output target for conversion from other formats. (e.g., DOCX → PDF, XLSX → PDF)

koreanSupport.title: 🎯 Korean Language Support
koreanSupport.description: Korean text is fully supported in all document conversions. Korean characters display correctly in PDF conversions without showing as squares (□).

unsupported.description: The following file formats are not supported for security reasons:

types.pdf: ⚠️ PDF files (.pdf) - Cannot be used as input

warnings.title: ⚠️ Important Notes
warnings.pdf: • **PDF:** Conversion to PDF from other formats is possible, but conversion from PDF to other formats is not supported
warnings.presentation: • **Presentations:** PPT, PPTX, ODP files are not supported by LibreOffice converter
warnings.spreadsheetPdf: • **Spreadsheet PDF:** Excel to PDF conversion is currently not supported
warnings.apple: • Apple formats are not supported due to compatibility issues
warnings.archive: • Archive files are not supported due to content verification difficulties
warnings.executable: • Executable files are blocked for security reasons
warnings.corrupted: • Corrupted files may fail to convert

unsupportedFile.title: Unsupported File Format
unsupportedFile.description: **{{fileName}}** is a {{fileType}} and is currently not supported for conversion.

pdfGuide.title: 📄 **PDF Conversion Guide:**
pdfGuide.output: • PDF can only be used as a conversion **output target**
pdfGuide.examples: • Convert other documents to PDF: DOCX → PDF, XLSX → PDF, PPTX → PDF
pdfGuide.limitation: • Conversion from PDF to other formats is not possible due to technical limitations

alternatives.title: 💡 Please try using files in the following formats instead:
alternatives.document: • Documents: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, TXT (can be converted to PDF)
alternatives.image: • Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP
